build_equivariant_layer_norm: build a python module using EquivariantLayerNormArray to normalize equivariant features of shape N sphere_basis C
build_layer_norm_spherical_harmonics: build a python module using EquivariantLayerNormArraySphericalHarmonics to normalize features across spherical harmonic degrees L greater than 0
build_rms_norm_spherical_harmonics_v2: build a python module using EquivariantRMSNormArraySphericalHarmonicsV2 to apply RMS normalization across all spherical harmonic degrees with optional centering
create_normalization_layer_factory: create a python module using get_normalization_layer to instantiate a normalization layer by name such as layer_norm or rms_norm_sh
build_degree_layer_scale: build a python module using EquivariantDegreeLayerScale to scale equivariant features by degree with learnable affine weights
